clinical.citation: ASHG 2017 - ARID4A de novo variants identified by exome sequencing among individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders (Monaghan et al.)

variants.description: One frameshift variant (specific notation not provided); de novo
phenotypes: variable features across cohort: autism, developmental regression, tone abnormalities, intellectual disability, brain anomalies, facial dysmorphism

variants.description: Five missense variants (specific notation not provided); four confirmed de novo, one possibly paternally mosaic (not confirmed de novo)
phenotypes: brain anomalies on MRI (thin corpus callosum, absent septum pellucidum, holoprosencephaly in one; pontocerebellar atrophy in another)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo on trio-based exome sequencing (one possible paternal mosaic); missense variants had damaging in-silico predictions and affected evolutionarily conserved residues

clinical.citation: Zhang et al. 2022 - A novel heterozygous missense variant of the ARID4A gene identified in Han Chinese families with schizophrenia-diagnosed siblings that interferes with DNA-binding activity (PMID: 35365808)

phenotypes: schizophrenia (affected siblings in Han Chinese families)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Identified by WES in families with schizophrenia-diagnosed siblings; functional studies showed a less compact ARID domain conformation, weaker dsDNA binding, and disrupted G1 cell cycle arrest with increased proliferation

clinical.citation: Deciphering the genetic basis of developmental language disorder in children without intellectual disability, autism or apraxia of speech (PMID: 39948625)

phenotypes: severe developmental language disorder (without ID, ASD or CAS)

clinical.diagnostic_reason: Frameshift variant in a gene intolerant to LoF variation, with no established Mendelian disorder yet; listed as a candidate variant and not classified as pathogenic

clinical.citation: The genetic landscape of autism spectrum disorder in an ancestrally diverse cohort (PMID: 39632905)
clinical.diagnostic_reason: De novo nonsynonymous variant in a candidate ASD gene (family MC_172_3)

model_organism.citation: Wu et al. 2013 - ARID4A and ARID4B regulate male fertility, a functional link to the AR and RB pathways (PMID: 23487765)
model_organism.knockout_type: full knockout (Arid4a-/- combined with Arid4b heterozygous knockout; Arid4a-/-Arid4b+/-)
phenotypes: spermatogenic arrest at meiotic spermatocyte and postmeiotic haploid spermatid stages
increased permeability of the blood-testis barrier (seminiferous tubules)
Sertoli cell dysfunction recapitulating Sertoli-specific AR and RB knockout phenotypes
altered expression of AR- and RB-responsive genes

model_organism.citation: Wu et al. 2008 - Identification of chromatin remodeling genes Arid4a and Arid4b as leukemia suppressor genes (PMID: 18728284)
phenotypes: ineffective hematopoiesis in all lineages in young mice
monocytosis, severe anemia and thrombocytopenia after 5 months of age
progression to acute myeloid leukemia (5 of 42 Arid4a-/- mice; 10 of 12 Arid4a-/-Arid4b+/- mice)
decreased Hoxb3, Hoxb5, Hoxb6 and Hoxb8 expression in bone marrow
reduced FoxP3 expression in Arid4a-/-Arid4b+/- bone marrow
increased histone trimethylation of H3K4, H3K9 and H4K20
model_organism.significance: Histone trimethylation fold increases: H3K4 32-fold (95% CI 27-32), H3K9 45-fold (95% CI 41-49), H4K20 2.2-fold (95% CI 1.7-2.7); statistical tests two-sided

biological.citation: Hu et al. 2017 - miR-376c promotes carcinogenesis and serves as a plasma marker for gastric carcinoma (PMID: 28486502)
biological.summary: ARID4A is a direct target of miR-376c in gastric carcinoma cells. ARID4A knockdown increased proliferation, migration and anchorage-independent growth, and ARID4A was strongly downregulated in tumor tissue, opposite to miR-376c. This supports a tumor-suppressor role.

biological.citation: Downregulation of ARID4A and ARID4B promote tumor progression and directly regulated by microRNA-30d in patient with prostate cancer (PMID: 29797600)
biological.summary: ARID4A is a miR-30d target and its mRNA is negatively correlated with miR-30d in prostate cancer tissue. It is downregulated in tumors with high Gleason score, PSA failure and short recurrence-free survival. ARID4A knockout promoted PCa cell proliferation, migration and invasion in vitro.
biological.significance: r=-0.313, P=0.001 (miR-30d vs ARID4A); P=0.005 (Gleason); P=0.012 (PSA failure); P=0.033 (recurrence-free survival)

biological.citation: Structural basis for tunable affinity and specificity of LxCxE-dependent protein interactions with the retinoblastoma protein family (PMID: 35716663)
biological.summary: Crystal structures and binding data show that an ARID4A LxCxE peptide binds the p107 pocket domain, alongside HDAC1 and EID1 peptides. This confirms ARID4A as a direct Rb-family-binding transcriptional co-repressor with defined affinity and specificity.

biological.citation: Wu et al. 2006 - Deficiency of Rbbp1/Arid4a and Rbbp1l1/Arid4b alters epigenetic modifications and suppresses an imprinting defect in the PWS/AS domain (PMID: 17043311)
biological.summary: Arid4a was recovered in a gene-trap screen for regulators of Snrpn-EGFP imprinting. It interacts with Arid4b and the Snrpn promoter. In mice, Arid4a-/- with Arid4b+/- reduced H4K20me3, H3K9me3 and DNA methylation at the PWS-IC and suppressed an AS imprinting defect, placing ARID4A in epigenetic complexes regulating PWS/AS imprinting.

biological.citation: AlphaFold-guided structural analyses of nucleosome binding proteins (PMID: 40794873)
biological.summary: An AlphaFold-based screen of more than 7600 human nuclear proteins identified ARID4A and ARID4B as novel nucleosome-binding proteins.

biological.citation: A novel heterozygous missense variant of the ARID4A gene identified in Han Chinese families with schizophrenia-diagnosed siblings that interferes with DNA-binding activity (PMID: 35365808)
biological.summary: Whole-exome sequencing found ARID4A p.His411Asp in schizophrenia families. The crystal structure of the PWWP-ARID tandem shows a structural supramodule. The mutant ARID domain is less compact and binds dsDNA more weakly, reduces G0-G1 arrest and increases HEK293T proliferation.
biological.sample_size: Han Chinese families with schizophrenia-diagnosed siblings

biological.citation: ASHG 2017 - ARID4A de novo variants identified by exome sequencing among individuals with neurodevelopmental disorders
biological.summary: Trio exome sequencing of 11,649 NDD probands found de novo ARID4A variants (one frameshift, five missense) in 6 individuals. All had developmental delay and behavioral abnormalities, and many had autism, tone abnormalities, regression or brain anomalies. A prior 14q23 deletion including ARID4A suggests haploinsufficiency.

biological.citation: ASHG 2014 - Position effects modify gene expression in a ring chromosome 14?
biological.summary: ARID4A was significantly downregulated in blood from a patient with ring chromosome 14 compared with 7 controls, possibly through position effects or nuclear repositioning of the ring chromosome. GeneMania indicated ARID4A is co-expressed with the other studied genes.

biological.citation: Structural basis for the DNA-binding activity of human ARID4B Tudor domain (PMID: 33675746)
biological.summary: The ARID4A N-terminal domain is an interdigitated double Tudor domain with DNA-binding activity. It has higher DNA affinity than the ARID4B Tudor domain, largely because of Leu50 (Glu50 in ARID4B), despite more than 80% sequence identity.

biological.citation: ARID4A and ARID4B regulate male fertility, a functional link to the AR and RB pathways (PMID: 23487765)
biological.summary: Arid4a-/-Arid4b+/- mice show progressive loss of male fertility, hypogonadism, spermatogenic arrest and an impaired blood-testis barrier. Arid4a is expressed mainly in Sertoli cells. ARID4A and ARID4B act as transcriptional coactivators in the AR and RB pathways, regulating AR- and RB-responsive genes.
